result.summary: Page renders largely correctly with no critical breakage, but found 3 minor visual issues: truncated carousel title at the right edge, inconsistent favorite-button styling, and bottom content clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row shows restaurant name as 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off mid-character at the right screen edge without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal list end-padding and use text ellipsis truncation so titles do not appear clipped mid-letter.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons have inconsistent styling: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows white outline with no background, while the pizza card below shows white outline inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent circular scrim/background to all favorite buttons to ensure visibility and visual consistency.

issues.description: Bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is flush against and abruptly clipped by the bottom tab bar with no spacing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so scrolling content is not obscured behind the navigation bar.
